name: p4-gi-build
command: bash scripts/build-global-illumination.sh

name: p4-gi-volume-check
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs check --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/volume --stage volume

name: p4-gi-volume-select
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs select --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/volume --stage volume

name: p4-gi-volume-clean
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs clean --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/volume --stage volume

name: p4-gi-volume-render
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs render --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/volume --stage volume

name: p4-gi-volume-fresh
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs fresh --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/volume --stage volume

name: p4-gi-volume-judge
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs judge --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/volume --stage volume --budget-s 1020

name: p4-gi-lighting-check
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs check --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/lighting --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-lighting-select
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs select --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/lighting --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-lighting-clean
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs clean --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/lighting --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-lighting-render
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs render --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/lighting --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-lighting-fresh
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs fresh --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/lighting --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-lighting-judge-local
command: node --test web/common/gi-job.test.mjs "examples/global-illumination/*.test.mjs"

name: p4-gi-lighting-judge
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs judge --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/lighting --stage lighting --budget-s 1020

name: p4-gi-area-probe-check
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs check --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/area-probe --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-area-probe-select
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs select --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/area-probe --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-area-probe-clean
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs clean --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/area-probe --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-area-probe-render
command: node web/common/gi-job.mjs render --page dist/global-illumination --out out/global-illumination/area-probe --stage lighting

name: p4-gi-area-ratio-stored
command: node scripts/gi-cornell-ratio.mjs --stored lighting --out out/global-illumination/area-probe --reference /refs/cornell-box-reference.png

name: p4-gi-area-probe-ratio
command: node scripts/gi-cornell-ratio.mjs --out out/global-illumination/area-probe --reference /refs/cornell-box-reference.png

name: p4-gi-lighting-ratio
command: node scripts/gi-cornell-ratio.mjs --out out/global-illumination/lighting --reference /refs/cornell-box-reference.png

name: p4-taa-lookdev-build
command: bash scripts/build-lookdev.sh

name: p4-taa-lookdev-check
command: env LOOKDEV_DIST=dist/lookdev node --test examples/lookdev/test/m31-taa.test.mjs

name: p4-taa-lookdev-render
command: node scripts/lookdev-capture.mjs --milestone m31 --judge --ref-prefix /refs/
